name:
Etrian Odyssey™ IV:
Legends of the Titan
formal_name:
Etrian Odyssey™ IV:
Legends of the Titan
description:
Etrian Odyssey IV brings an enhanced
graphics engine boasting polygonal
enemies and new 3D special effects;
upgradable, customizable skyships
that let players travel and battle amid
the clouds. An exceedingly
atmospheric and fully orchestrated
musical score from Yuzo Koshiro in
addition to expanded, more immersive
3D dungeons with analog camera
control rounds up the features of the
newest addition to this beloved
franchise.
disclaimer:
Due to the size of this game, it may take longer to download the digital version of this title when compared to other Nintendo eShop games. At the time of purchase you can choose either “Download Now” to begin to download the game immediately or
“Download Later” to download the game when the system enters “sleep mode.”


You may need an additional compatible SD card or SDHC card with available space to download this software. Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
